name: zinput_bindgroup_list_add_command_to_group
description: zInput::BindGroupList_AddCommandToGroup appends a command id to the selected bind group's command-id vector, growing storage when capacity is exhausted.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput bind-group vector pass.

Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja HLIL preserves VC5SP3 vector insertion template branches for append-at-end; assembly comments document the effective source-level append and reallocation behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x42a2c0 validates selection of g_zInput_BindGroupInfoList[groupIndex]->commandIds, in-place append when capacity permits, and reallocation that copies existing ids, stores the new id, deletes old storage, and updates begin/end/cap.
The dependency frontier has accepted source/provider coverage for allocator/delete, zUtil vector helper provider operations, and StdPtrVector::ClearNoOpDestroy.

The native bind-group smoke verifies appending to an empty command-id vector, appending a second command through the default-binding path, command count/id accessors, and default-bindings construction across multiple bind groups.
